Both print to stdout; successful main exits 0. validate_approval separately returns approvalReceipt.v1 statuses VALID/INVALID/ERROR, with findings and claim ceiling, not via this CLI.

error.description: argparse rejects absent/unknown CLI commands and missing choices (exit 2); unhandled Python/fixture assertions propagate nonzero. API validate_approval, when its manifest source reads succeed, catches malformed/missing explicit as_of, closed subject/evidence, wrong engine identity or grants and reports ERROR; nonconforming provider/grant evidence returns INVALID with findings, not unconditional CLI process failure. Own-source read/hash failure may escape, including while constructing an ERROR receipt; the evaluator does not guarantee an error envelope if that helper fails.

Engine manifest comparisons and repeated result/error digests can reread source bytes; no single stable source-read snapshot is guaranteed. Arbitrary supplied Python subclasses can also execute caller deepcopy/attribute hooks; ordinary declared JSON-data behavior does not prove universal caller purity.
